scope: 29 false negatives recovered by the February 2026 full-row fresh-context audit

items.title: SALAAD: Sparse And Low-Rank Adaptation via ADMM for Large Language Model Inference
items.anchor_query: elastic post-training sparsity / memory-budget fallback
items.rationale: Ch54 already binds sparse/low-rank or quantized capacity variants to deployment memory budgets, quality validation and dense fallback; SALAAD adds a particular ADMM training construction, not a new inference-memory ownership contract.

items.title: Chance-Constrained Inference for Hallucination Risk Control in Large Language Models
items.anchor_query: Accepted-generation Risk 需要 Chance Constraint
items.rationale: Ch20 separates proposal, verification and commit but did not distinguish confidence-based selection from an anytime-valid chance constraint over accepted generations under repeated use.

integration.insertion_heading: Accepted-generation Risk 需要 Chance Constraint，不是 Confidence Threshold
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Treat each generation as a stochastic constraint trial and use sequential anytime-valid evidence to accept, defer or declare infeasibility against a versioned risk budget.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Sampling cost and scorer or independence drift can invalidate the certificate; keep fixed decoding or ordinary selective prediction for low-risk latency-sensitive paths.

items.title: Learning to Route and Schedule LLMs from User Retrials via Contextual Queueing Bandits
items.anchor_query: User Retrial 是 Endogenous Arrival
items.rationale: Ch56 covers online routing and queue state but did not model user retrials as both implicit preference feedback and endogenous workload that feeds the scheduler backlog.

integration.insertion_heading: User Retrial 是 Endogenous Arrival，不是独立新请求
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Bind retrial lineage, prior route, completion and queue state so routing learns implicit preference while queue stability retains commit authority.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Network retries and duplicate clicks can masquerade as preference, while exploration harms SLO; fall back to explicit feedback and FIFO/EDF/aging when lineage is unreliable.

items.title: Building a Correct-by-Design Lakehouse. Data Contracts, Versioning, and Transactional Pipelines for Humans and Agents
items.anchor_query: Data Contract 要延伸到整次 Pipeline Commit
items.rationale: Ch27 versions dataset identities and transformation lineage but did not connect typed table contracts, Git-like data branches and atomic multi-output pipeline publication into one correctness boundary.

integration.insertion_heading: Data Contract 要延伸到整次 Pipeline Commit
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Validate transformations in an isolated data revision and move the authoritative head only with a single pipeline commit that publishes all outputs.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Version graphs, conflict resolution and multi-table transactions add cost and are not production throughput proof; single-writer or single-table snapshots remain valid baselines.

items.title: Trust by Design: Skill Profiles for Transparent, Cost-Aware LLM Routing
items.anchor_query: quality-target cost routing
items.rationale: Ch70 already requires task/quality/SLO identity, model-path cost and fallback to be evaluated together; interpretable skill profiles are one router feature implementation rather than a new cost-owner contract.

items.title: Accurate Failure Prediction in Agents Does Not Imply Effective Failure Prevention
items.anchor_query: Critic Accuracy 不等于 Intervention Value
items.rationale: Ch80 treats critics as fallible sensors but did not state the causal disruption-recovery trade-off or require a paired pilot before enabling proactive intervention.

integration.insertion_heading: Critic Accuracy 不等于 Intervention Value
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Gate intervention on paired pilot evidence for recovered failures minus disrupted successes and intervention cost, rather than on critic AUROC.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Pilot estimates drift across task and model mixtures; uncertainty or high-risk actions should disable automatic interruption and escalate verification.

items.title: Attack Selection Reduces Safety in Concentrated AI Control Settings against Trusted Monitoring
items.anchor_query: Control Evaluation 要测试 Attacker 如何选择攻击时机
items.rationale: Ch72 covers adaptive attacks and attempt budgets but did not bind attack-quality scoring and submission policy to monitoring FPR under a concentrated audit budget.

integration.insertion_heading: Control Evaluation 要测试 Attacker 如何选择攻击时机
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Freeze generator, attack-quality estimator, submission policy, opportunity and audit budget so selective low-frequency attacks are part of the control evaluation.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Results remain a lower bound conditioned on red-team capability and candidate distribution; retain independent audits, least privilege and safe commit.

items.title: SweetSpot: An Analytical Model for Predicting Energy Efficiency of LLM Inference
items.anchor_query: Generation Energy 不是 Token 数的线性函数
items.rationale: Ch70 records input/output lengths and energy attribution, but it did not make the nonlinear two-dimensional generation-energy surface and workload-specific local operating point explicit.

integration.insertion_heading: Generation Energy 不是 Token 数的线性函数
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Calibrate energy over the joint input/output-length surface and evaluate truncation, summarization or generation budgets against energy per successful goal.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: The operating point moves with runtime, batching, KV cache and hardware; analytical estimates are proposals and require current quality/SLO and energy receipts.

items.title: Beyond Static Alignment: Hierarchical Policy Control for LLM Safety via Risk-Aware Chain-of-Thought
items.anchor_query: hierarchical runtime safety policy
items.rationale: Ch72 already separates immutable global policy, tenant/user policy, learned risk sensors and deterministic action authorization; PACT supplies a bounded Classify-to-Act implementation without changing those authorities.

items.title: Anchored Decoding: Provably Reducing Copyright Risk for Any Language Model
items.anchor_query: Anchored Decoding 把版权风险编译为序列信息预算
items.rationale: Ch20 covers constrained and safety-aware decoding but not a sequence-level information budget that keeps a risky proposal distribution near a permissively trained reference, including cross-vocabulary byte fusion.

integration.insertion_heading: Anchored Decoding 把版权风险编译为序列信息预算
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Allocate a versioned sequence information budget across token steps and constrain risky-LM proposals against a permissive reference distribution before commit.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Dual-model cost, utility loss and reference-data provenance remain; it is not a legal compliance certificate and must coexist with output review.

items.title: Aegis: Towards Governance, Integrity, and Security of AI Voice Agents
items.anchor_query: channel-specific layered agent defense
items.rationale: Ch72 already treats modality/channel identity, access control, behavior policy and monitoring as separate layers; the voice-agent cases broaden scenarios without changing that security contract.

items.title: SAGE: Scalable AI Governance & Evaluation
items.anchor_query: policy precedent surrogate judge calibration loop
items.rationale: Ch66 already versions policy/rubric, precedent, human calibration, surrogate judge and distillation cost as separate evaluation authorities with regression gates.

items.title: The Judge Who Never Admits: Hidden Shortcuts in LLM-based Evaluation
items.anchor_query: judge shortcut and cue invariance
items.rationale: Ch66 already requires controlled cue perturbations, judge disagreement/bias checks, configuration identity and independent adjudication; unacknowledged recency/provenance cues are an instance of that existing contract.

items.title: On Protecting Agentic Systems' Intellectual Property via Watermarking
items.anchor_query: agent provenance and watermark verification
items.rationale: Ch72 already separates provenance metadata, watermark signal, model/action-path revision and inconclusive verification, including false positive/negative and transformation limits.

items.title: From Assistant to Double Agent: Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks on OpenClaw for Personalized Local AI Agent
items.anchor_query: persistent local-agent attack state
items.rationale: Ch72 already models persistent memory, delayed triggers, tool effects and local-agent supply-chain boundaries; the OpenClaw benchmark adds a bounded target, not a new owner contract.

items.title: Stateless Yet Not Forgetful: Implicit Memory as a Hidden Channel in LLMs
items.anchor_query: Stateless API 仍可能承载跨调用的 Implicit Memory
items.rationale: Ch77 governs explicit external and parametric memory but did not identify output-mediated state re-injection as an implicit hidden channel lacking record identity, ACL, expiry and deletion semantics.

integration.insertion_heading: Stateless API 仍可能承载跨调用的 Implicit Memory
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Audit predecessor-output re-injection as memory state by binding output, normalization, transport, wrapper and later behavior with matched temporal controls.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Scrubbing can damage utility and cannot prove all encodings removed; high-risk paths should use typed handoffs or prohibit free-text return.

items.title: Sparse Models, Sparse Safety: Unsafe Routes in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
items.anchor_query: MoE routing as security state
items.rationale: Ch72 already makes router revision, expert assignment distribution, input perturbation and independent safety slices part of the MoE security contract, with dense/end-to-end fallback.

items.title: Timing and Memory Telemetry on GPUs for AI Governance
items.anchor_query: Host 与 Device 都不可信时的旁路遥测
items.rationale: Ch67 covers trusted counters and indirect telemetry but did not define active compute challenges combining parallel work, sequential delay, GEMM and VRAM-residency evidence when host and device counters are untrusted.

integration.insertion_heading: Host 与 Device 都不可信时，用计算挑战构造旁路遥测
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Use versioned active compute challenges to produce statistical utilization evidence without trusting firmware or vendor counters.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Challenge overhead and architectural drift are substantial, and evidence cannot identify model purpose; emit suspect or unknown and retain attestation/manual investigation.

items.title: Stop Testing Attacks, Start Diagnosing Defenses: The Four-Checkpoint Framework Reveals Where LLM Safety Breaks
items.anchor_query: stage-specific safety checkpoints
items.rationale: Ch72 already separates input/output, literal/semantic detection, proposal/authorization/commit and weighted severity; the four-checkpoint taxonomy is an existing-coverage specialization.

items.title: Why Do AI Agents Systematically Fail at Cloud Root Cause Analysis?
items.anchor_query: Multi-Agent Failure 按 Intra / Inter / Environment 分层
items.rationale: Ch82 tracks handoffs and constraint survival but did not require failures to be attributed across intra-agent reasoning, inter-agent communication and agent-environment interaction before choosing a repair.

integration.insertion_heading: Multi-Agent Failure 要按 Intra / Inter / Environment 分层归因
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Record earliest evidence-backed failure span, responsibility layer, affected handoff/state and outcome so repairs target the actual layer.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Richer protocols add cost and can propagate errors; use single-agent deterministic verification for simple tasks and do not generalize benchmark failure rates.

items.title: Authenticated Workflows: A Systems Approach to Protecting Agentic AI
items.anchor_query: authenticated intent and integrity at workflow boundaries
items.rationale: Ch72 already binds authenticated principal/delegation, data-flow authority, signed artifacts, effect-time policy and workflow provenance; MAPL and framework adapters are a concrete protocol, not a new durable boundary.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in Partial TEE-Shielded LLM Inference with Precomputed Noise
items.anchor_query: Partial TEE 协议的秘密随机性不得跨请求复用
items.rationale: Ch72 covers TEE scope, nonce/replay and split-inference leakage, but did not state that precomputed static secret bases can become reusable keying material that breaks both confidentiality and integrity.

integration.insertion_heading: Partial TEE 协议的秘密随机性不得跨请求复用
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Make entropy source, nonce/counter, request binding, key epoch, allowed reuse and recovery part of the partial-TEE protocol identity.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Fresh secrets add enclave and communication cost; without provable domain separation, fall back to fuller trusted execution, MPC or a narrower confidentiality claim.

items.title: HiFloat4 Format for Language Model Inference
items.anchor_query: low-bit format identity and hardware execution
items.rationale: Ch49 already treats bit layout, group/scaling metadata, accumulator precision, kernel support, accuracy and hardware area/power as one versioned execution-plan contract.

items.title: RooflineBench: A Benchmarking Framework for On-Device LLMs via Roofline Analysis
items.anchor_query: roofline evaluation envelope
items.rationale: Ch66 already separates operational intensity, hardware ceilings, model shape/sequence length and cross-device evaluation envelopes; Relative Inference Potential is an additional metric inside that contract.

items.title: AgentLeak: A Benchmark for Internal-Channel Privacy Leakage in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.anchor_query: multi-agent internal-channel privacy
items.rationale: Ch72 already audits messages, shared memory, tool arguments and final output as distinct privacy channels and rejects output-only assurance; AgentLeak supplies a bounded benchmark instance.

items.title: Learning to Configure Agentic AI Systems
items.anchor_query: query-specific agent configuration policy
items.rationale: Ch84 already represents workflow, tools, prompt and budget as a versioned option catalog selected per query, while commit and fallback remain platform authorities.

items.title: Evaluating LLM Safety Under Repeated Inference via Accelerated Prompt Stress Testing
items.anchor_query: Safety Evaluation 还需要 Depth-oriented Repeated Inference
items.rationale: Ch66 asks for repeated runs and variance, but did not separate breadth coverage from depth-oriented estimation of per-inference failure frequency under identical operational conditions.

integration.insertion_heading: Safety Evaluation 还需要 Depth-oriented Repeated Inference
integration.durable_mechanism_delta: Freeze prompt family, runtime, sampling and scorer, then report repeated-sampling failure probability, interval, first-failure depth and correlation separately from breadth coverage.
integration.trade_off_failure_mode: Cost, cache/provider drift and correlated samples limit inference; keep breadth benchmarks and mark unseen failure bounds unresolved when depth is insufficient.

items.title: Towards Fair and Comprehensive Evaluation of Routers in Collaborative LLM Systems
items.anchor_query: router evaluation by ability scenario and robustness
items.rationale: Ch66 already requires routing quality, scenario alignment, cost/privacy constraints and OOD robustness to be evaluated as separate axes under a frozen router/model envelope.

items.title: MalTool: Malicious Tool Attacks on LLM Agents
items.anchor_query: malicious tool implementation and executable admission
items.rationale: Ch72 already requires tool code and dependencies to be scanned, sandbox-executed and admitted from legitimate-task plus malicious-effect receipts; generated malicious implementations expand the test corpus without changing the gate.
